Package com.j3d.engine.scene

Class Camera

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventEmitter
com.j3d.engine.scene.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventEmitterInterface
public class Camera extends EventEmitter
Represents the virtual camera in the 3D scene.

The camera defines the viewpoint from which the scene is rendered. It holds its own position and orientation (rotation) in world space. It also contains the projection plane, which determines the field of view and focal length for the 3D-to-2D projection.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

  • Field Details

    • position

      private Vector3 position
      The 3D position of the camera in the world (c).

    • rotation

      private Rotation rotation
      The orientation of the camera, defined by pitch, yaw, and roll angles.

    • projectionPlane

      private Vector3 projectionPlane
      The position of the display surface relative to the camera's local coordinate system. The Z-component of this vector is the most critical, acting as the focal length (zoom). A larger Z-value results in a narrower field of view (more zoom).

    • getForward

      public Vector3 getForward()
      Calculates the camera's forward-facing direction vector in world space. This is determined by transforming a local "forward" vector (0, 0, 1) using the camera's current yaw and pitch.
      Returns:
      A normalized Vector3 representing the direction the camera is pointing.

    • getRight

      public Vector3 getRight()
      Calculates the camera's right-facing direction vector in world space. This is determined by transforming a local "right" vector (1, 0, 0) using the camera's current yaw and pitch.
      Returns:
      A normalized Vector3 representing the direction the camera is pointing.

    • getUp

      public Vector3 getUp()
      Calculates the camera's up-facing direction vector in world space. This is determined by transforming a local "up" vector (0, 1, 0) using the camera's current yaw and pitch. Roll is ignored.
      Returns:
      A normalized Vector3 representing the direction the camera is pointing.

    • lookAt

      public void lookAt(Vector3 target)
      Orients the camera to look at a specific target point in world space. This method calculates the necessary pitch and yaw to align the camera's forward vector with the direction from its current position to the target. The camera's roll is set to 0.
      Parameters:
      target - The world-space Vector3 point to look at.

    • viewPlane

      public NormalPlane viewPlane()
      Returns a NormalPlane representing the camera's view plane. This plane is defined by the camera's position and its forward-facing direction.
      Returns:
      A NormalPlane representing the camera's view plane.
